purpose: Independent linear-wave reflection characterization; not an airfoil validation or a replacement boundary prescription
method: Pinned D3Q27 cumulant, zero-centered, molecular lattice viscosity 0.04*32/30000, bulk frequency default1
measurement: Rplus=delta_uy+cs*delta_rho incident maximum during steps20..130; Rminus=delta_uy-cs*delta_rho reflected maximum during steps140..330; record ratio, including propagation/damping to probe, not a universal boundary coefficient
checks: finite states, exact prescribed small initial perturbation, same bulk/shear and pulse in both cases; no selected reflection pass/fail threshold or physical accuracy claim
caution: An extrapolation outflow is not automatically a valid farfield condition for mixed incoming/outgoing multidimensional airfoil flow; no production boundary will be changed just to damp coefficients
